segments.name: Dx
products: clinical, anatomic pathology, genetic, and genomic tests
segments.description: Provides routine and specialty/esoteric clinical laboratory testing, including anatomic pathology and genomic tests, to physicians, hospitals, health plans, and patients.
segments.evidence: Dx offers a comprehensive menu of frequently requested core testing and specialty testing through an integrated network of primary and specialty laboratories across the U.S. and Canada.

segments.name: BLS
segments.description: Central Laboratory and ED businesses serving pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device and diagnostic companies and CROs in the U.S. and other countries.
segments.evidence: The Company is organized under two segments: Dx, which includes routine testing and specialty/esoteric testing; and BLS, consisting of Central Laboratory and ED businesses.

revenueModel.text: Physicians and other providers, health plans, Medicare and Medicaid, patients, and pharmaceutical and biotech companies pay for laboratory testing and drug development services.
revenueModel.evidence: Clients. Physicians and other healthcare providers who are authorized to order clinical laboratory testing for their patients are a primary source of requests for Dx's testing services.

changes.text: In 2023 the Company separated its Fortrea business, formerly CDCS, into a separate publicly traded company and recast segment results to exclude it.
changes.evidence: In addition, as a result of the Spin-off, the Company recast segment results to exclude the historical results of the CDCS business for all periods presented.
